_kill_switch: Set `enabled` to false to suspend ALL autonomous processing. One field, one file. Suspension never rewrites lane history.
_live_vs_historical: Two kinds of field live in this file. LIVE operational fields (enabled, mode, auto_merge, the automatic_* prohibitions, stuck_lane_threshold_hours) always take effect from their current value — that is what makes the kill switch a kill switch. ADMISSION fields (authorized_corridor, actor_allowlist, maximum_patch_cycles, lease_duration_minutes) decide whether a DURABLE PAST event was admissible, so they are versioned in `admission_history`: each event is judged under the epoch governing its authenticated GitHub comment time, never under today's value.
_admission_history: Append-only. Every already-accepted epoch is digest-locked by ACCEPTED_ADMISSION_EPOCH_LOCKS in .straylight/lib/admission-locks.mjs — executable protocol code OUTSIDE this file. Editing an accepted epoch here makes the policy fail closed everywhere; making it pass again requires changing that protocol code too, which is an exact-SHA reviewed repository change and NOT an ordinary policy edit. Adding a new epoch means appending it here AND appending its lock there.
_projection: authorized_corridor, actor_allowlist, maximum_patch_cycles and lease_duration_minutes at top level are a REQUIRED, read-only PROJECTION of the final (current) epoch, kept so tools can read current admission policy without walking the history. They are validated deep-equal to the final epoch and carry no historical authority: the reducer resolves admission from the epoch governing the event's observed time, never from here.
_actor_allowlist: GitHub commenter identity is the only authenticated identity available in v1/v2; actor_role is a claimed field, not a cryptographic identity (ADR-050 §6). All model roles currently map to the operator's account. Distinct bot identities are a hard precondition for ever enabling auto_merge. github-actions[bot] is allowlisted for SYSTEM events only — it must never appear under operator, or workflow-posted comments could claim operator authority.

provenance.note: Transcribes, without alteration, the four admission fields of straylight.automation-policy.v1 as committed at main 5625c5be425c71fce90a22e81d123b42ed104538 — the policy under which every durable control-plane event up to that commit was admitted. governs_from is the authenticated GitHub created_at of the earliest durable protocol event in the repository (lane-phase-49p sequence 1, issue #118 comment 5080520742); it records when the replayable history begins, and asserts nothing about authorization before that instant. Attribution is descriptive metadata, not authentication: force comes from the reviewed repository change that introduced this epoch and its executable lock.
